subject: COM
label: Grade 04
task: Meet the outcome of every unit in Grade 04 Computing, and keep one piece of evidence for each.
condition: A 36-week school year, 4 units, a teacher or guide, a learning book or device, and local examples in the local language first with English support.
standard: Each unit: at least 4 of 5 attempts correct, said or written, with one real example from home or school. Course pass: no unit at 'Not yet' after one retry, and a pass in SA1 and SA2.

modules.title: Presentations
modules.outcome: make a short slide presentation with text and pictures
modules.intro: In this unit you work on 'Presentations', taught in a way that is short, playful, with objects, pictures and talk. The target is clear: make a short slide presentation with text and pictures. You move from seeing it, to saying it, to doing it alone.
points: See it: watch or try the skill in 'Presentations' on a teacher screen or a safe device.
Name the parts: write the key words and what each part does.
Use it: make a short slide presentation with text and pictures. Save your work in a named file or folder.
Test and fix: run it, find one fault, correct it, and note what you changed.
modules.example: Solved: Slide 1 title; slide 2 three bullets of six words or fewer; slide 3 one picture. Check contrast and font size. Method: Model run for 'Presentations'. Goal in one sentence. Plan: list the steps in order before touching the device. Do: follow the plan, saving after each step. Test: try normal input and one unusual input. Fix: change one thing and test again. Share: show a partner and explain it. What a good answer looks like: it works for normal input, steps match the plan, and the learner can explain each part. Online safety rules apply at all times.
modules.activity: About 20 to 30 minutes of class work, then one short practice task for home. Keep evidence: one page in your learning book.
modules.standard: Make a short slide presentation with text and pictures: at least 4 of 5 attempts correct, said or written, with one real example from home or school.

ladder: L1: use a device safely; click, type and draw.
L2: create documents; follow simple instructions in blocks.
L3: spreadsheets, algorithms and simple programs.
L5: software design, databases and security.
L7 (postgraduate): research, architecture or AI practice.
